CREATE DATABASE synapseprojek

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE data_cuaca
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'abfss://datacuaca@adls1tcba.dfs.core.windows.net'
);

-- Membuat external file format 

CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT AirSenseCSV 
WITH ( 
   FORMAT_TYPE = DELIMITEDTEXT, 
   FORMAT_OPTIONS ( 
       FIELD_TERMINATOR = ',', 
       STRING_DELIMITER = '"', 
       FIRST_ROW = 2, 
       PARSER_VERSION = '2.0' 
   ) 
); 
GO 

SELECT
    name,
    location
FROM sys.external_data_sources

-- 1. Buat external table sederhana di atas data AQI 6 kota, lalu tampilkan isinya.

-- surakarta 
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.kualitas_udara_surakarta 
( 
   waktu        NVARCHAR(50), 
   pm10_ug_m3   FLOAT, 
   pm2_5_ug_m3  FLOAT, 
   no2_ug_m3    FLOAT, 
   so2_ug_m3    FLOAT, 
   o3_ug_m3     FLOAT, 
   co_ug_m3     FLOAT 
) 
WITH 
( 
   LOCATION = '/raw/data/surakarta/01/', 
   DATA_SOURCE = data_cuaca, 
   FILE_FORMAT = AirSenseCSV
);
GO
SELECT TOP 20 * 
FROM dbo.kualitas_udara_surakarta; 
GO

GO

-- 2. Hitung rata-rata, maksimum, dan minimum AQI per kota, serta tambahkan
--    1 query agregrasi bebas sesuai kreatifitas kalian

DROP VIEW dbo.v_gabungan;

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.v_gabungan AS
SELECT 
    t.filepath(1) AS kota,
    CAST(t.waktu AS DATETIME2) AS waktu_dt,
    t.pm10_ug_m3, 
    t.pm2_5_ug_m3, 
    t.no2_ug_m3, 
    t.so2_ug_m3, 
    t.o3_ug_m3, 
    t.co_ug_m3
FROM 
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK '/raw/data/*/*/*.csv',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'data_cuaca',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
        FIRSTROW = 2
    ) 
    WITH (
        waktu NVARCHAR(50),
        pm10_ug_m3 FLOAT,
        pm2_5_ug_m3 FLOAT,
        no2_ug_m3 FLOAT,
        so2_ug_m3 FLOAT,
        o3_ug_m3 FLOAT,
        co_ug_m3 FLOAT
    ) AS t;
GO

 -- rata-rata, maksimum, minimum per kota 
SELECT 
    kota,
    ROUND(AVG(pm2_5_ug_m3), 2) AS avg_pm2_5,
    MAX(pm2_5_ug_m3) AS max_pm2_5,
    MIN(pm2_5_ug_m3) AS min_pm2_5,
    ROUND(AVG(pm10_ug_m3), 2) AS avg_pm10,
    MAX(pm10_ug_m3) AS max_pm10,
    MIN(pm10_ug_m3) AS min_pm10,
    ROUND(AVG(no2_ug_m3), 2) AS avg_no2,
    MAX(no2_ug_m3) AS max_no2,
    MIN(no2_ug_m3) AS min_no2,
    ROUND(AVG(so2_ug_m3), 2) AS avg_so2,
    MAX(so2_ug_m3) AS max_so2,
    MIN(so2_ug_m3) AS min_so2,
    ROUND(AVG(o3_ug_m3), 2) AS avg_o3,
    MAX(o3_ug_m3) AS max_o3,
    MIN(o3_ug_m3) AS min_o3,
    ROUND(AVG(co_ug_m3), 2) AS avg_co,
    MAX(co_ug_m3) AS max_co,
    MIN(co_ug_m3) AS min_co
FROM dbo.v_gabungan
GROUP BY kota
ORDER BY kota;

-- peringkat kota dengan total populasi (akumulasi CO dan SO2) terparah
SELECT TOP 3
    kota,
    ROUND(SUM(co_ug_m3 + so2_ug_m3), 2) AS total_polusi_gas
FROM dbo.v_gabungan
GROUP BY kota
ORDER BY total_polusi_gas DESC;

-- 3. Tentukan kota dengan rata-rata AQI tertinggi selama bulan Januari 2026
SELECT
    kota,
    ROUND (AVG (pm2_5_ug_m3), 2) AS avg_pm2_5,
    ROUND (AVG (pm10_ug_m3), 2) AS avg_pm10,
    ROUND (AVG (no2_ug_m3), 2) AS avg_no2,
    ROUND (AVG (so2_ug_m3), 2) AS avg_so2,
    ROUND (AVG (o3_ug_m3), 2) AS avg_o3,
    ROUND (AVG (co_ug_m3), 2) AS avg_co
FROM dbo.v_gabungan
WHERE waktu_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND waktu_dt < '2026-02-01'
GROUP BY kota
ORDER BY avg_pm2_5 DESC;
